events.summary: Energy facilities in Qatar were attacked on 2 March 2026. The operator announced the same day that production of LNG and related products had stopped because of the attack.
events.effect: Production of LNG and related products stopped, as announced by the operator on 2 March 2026 (reported by Al Jazeera Arabic).
events.threshold_basis: Clause 1: the operator's own announcement, on the day, that production of LNG and related products had stopped because of an attack on its operating facilities.

review.process: Found by a research lane; then reviewed blind by three independent reviewers, none of whom saw the researcher's rationale or each other: one opened the sources and checked identity, date, region, threshold and every figure; one checked the text for placement finer than first-level region, inventories, dependency and status wording; one checked class, cause, hazard name, episode and duplicates. Published only because all three accepted it; their corrections were reconciled into this text.

publication.note: Attacks on this country's energy facilities are still being reported. Saying whether a struck facility is back in operation could help time another attack, so the event is published but the facility's restart, recovery and operating status are not, nor are reports of them, until the campaign has ended.
